headline:
رئيس Forza يتقاعد
بعد 27 عامًا
label: تقرير
note: Report: Turn 10 head Dan Greenawalt retiring from Microsoft after 27 years, per an internal memo obtained by The Verge (Tom Warren), relayed by Shacknews 29 Oct; adviser to Playground before leaving; helped found Turn 10, led Forza. Microsoft has not announced it publicly. No licensed photo found (Commons empty), so the Reel uses his best-known work (Forza Motorsport 20th Anniversary update trailer, Steam 2440510, clean racing stretch 31 to 70 s, title cards and stat text avoided). Trailer's own music.
